description: This file declares function pointer types, dispatch stubs, inline utility functions, and an output check related to adaptive pooling operations (average and max pooling in 2D and 3D) for tensors. It serves as a header for adaptive pooling implementations in the ATen native library of PyTorch.

methods.name: start_index
methods.description: Computes the start index for adaptive pooling based on input size, output size, and current index.

methods.name: int64_t end_index(int64_t a,int64_t b,int64_t c)
methods.description: Computes the end index for adaptive pooling based on input size, output size, and current index.

methods.name: void adaptive_pool_empty_output_check(const Tensor & gradOutput_,const char * arg_name)
methods.description: Checks that the gradient output tensor has non-zero sizes on non-batch dimensions and throws an error if any are empty.
